whatsappMessage:
Hi Team MG Cafe & Restro Swad-E- Bihar,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.8★ reviews with 290+ happy customers in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table booking, digital food menu, aur WhatsApp inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/swadebihar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team MG Cafe & Restro Swad-E- Bihar, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct digital menu, table reservation, and your 4.8-star local reviews in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
